en.heading: Choose a new mentor for m_c
en.info:
If an rusasi is 6 moons old and their mentor is changed, they will not be listed as a former rusasi on their old mentor's profile. Rusasirahs without a mentor will have one automatically assigned next moon. An rusasi's mentor can have an influence on their trait and skill later in life.
Choose your mentors wisely.

current_mentor.zero: m_c does not have a mentor

en.no_current_apprentices_tooltip: Only show mentors with no current rusasirahs
en.no_former_apprentices_tooltip: Only show mentors who have not had an rusasi
